Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

plotly.core 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.
  • Graph objects generated from the plotly.js (4.3.0) schema: a go_*() constructor for every trace type and layout object, add_<trace>(), update_layout(), update_traces() and friends, with plotly.py-style validation and generated documentation.
  • Plotly Express: all of plotly.py’s px.* functions as px_scatter(), px_line(), px_bar(), … plus px_imshow(), with faceting, marginals, trendlines, animation, the px.data datasets and templates.
  • make_subplots(), templates (default_template(), register_template()).
  • htmlwidget rendering: numeric arrays are sent as base64 typed arrays, arrays repeated in a figure are sent once, as_float32() sends data in single precision, and partial_bundle() loads a smaller plotly.js bundle.
  • write_html() saves figures as HTML pages faster than htmlwidgets::saveWidget().
  • Shiny (plotlyOutput(), renderPlotly(), event_data(), plotlyProxy()), knitr/Quarto output, and static image export with Kaleido (save_image()).
  • Renders the plotly R package’s plot_ly() and ggplotly() figures, including its crosstalk linking (highlight()).

Developed by Matthew Summersgill, Carson Sievert, Chris Parmer.
